text: 金十数据10月17日讯，当地时间15日，由中国银行举办的斯里兰卡人民币清算行揭牌仪式在斯里兰卡科伦坡举行。当天，来自斯里兰卡政府部门及中斯两国企业、金融机构的200余位代表参加了揭牌仪式。目前，中国银行是唯一在斯里兰卡展业的中资金融机构。在中国和斯里兰卡两国央行的支持下，中国银行科伦坡分行获任斯里兰卡人民币清算行，这将提升跨境清算效率和人民币服务质效。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 17: On October 15 local time, the unveiling ceremony for Bank of China's Sri Lanka RMB clearing bank was held in Colombo, Sri Lanka. More than 200 representatives from Sri Lankan government departments and Chinese and Sri Lankan enterprises and financial institutions attended the ceremony that day. Currently, Bank of China is the only Chinese financial institution operating in Sri Lanka. With the support of the central banks of China and Sri Lanka, Bank of China's Colombo branch was appointed as the RMB clearing bank for Sri Lanka, which will improve cross-border clearing efficiency and the quality and efficiency of RMB services.
